title: Isolate origin rewind and missing-witness regression refusal reasons
outcome: Origin regression tests fail when their specific rewind or missing-witness check is removed, independently of retained-artifact refusal.
acceptance: The same-origin database rewind test isolates or asserts the exchange-anchor divergence refusal, so leftover Git artifacts cannot satisfy it accidentally.
The export/import quarantine test asserts the missing-witness refusal specifically while preserving canonical IDs and bytes.
